description: What a process and everything it started cost, read at one sample.

pid.description: The process measured: the anchor of the flow's subscribers.

processes.description: The process and its descendants at the sample.

usage.description: CPU time the tree took since the previous sample, percent of one core: 250 is two and a half cores. It counts the children that ended and were waited for in between; a process that left the tree takes its time with it, and that sample counts 0.

rss_mib.description: Sum of the resident memories of the tree, MiB. A page shared by two of its processes counts twice.
